result.one_liner: BigCommerce is a fully-hosted ecommerce platform providing REST and GraphQL APIs for building storefronts and integrations.

evidence.quote: BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts
BigCommerce offers a fully functional 15-day free trial, during which you can test drive BigCommerce
BigCommerce's GraphQL Storefront API has one single endpoint: /graphql. REST APIs use multiple endpoints organized by resource type
Enterprise plan includes unlimited API calls for automation and integrated workflows across REST and GraphQL APIs
API access varies by plan. Enterprise requires conversation for unlimited API access. Different plans have different API limitations

result.notes: BigCommerce requires a paid subscription after the 15-day trial to maintain API access. OAuth2 is the documented authentication method. Both REST and GraphQL APIs are available. API rate limits and feature access vary by subscription tier. For a free developer account with persistent API access, a paid plan would be required.
